title: Sheehan represented John Mack and vetted experiencers

tellings.quote: well I I represented him for 10 years uh and uh met dozens of people uh that he had worked with

plain: A lawyer named Dan Sheehan tells podcast host Jesse Michels that from the 1990s until about 2004 he was the legal representative of John Mack, a man at Harvard who worked with people who say they have had contact with non-human beings, often called experiencers. Sheehan says that over those ten years he met dozens of the people Mack had worked with. If his account holds, it means a lawyer saw these witnesses up close and took their stories seriously.
